header.superHtml:
"Bristles the Brushineer grew up alongside The Tooth Keri, spending his days protecting their castle. Now, he's all grown up and has added protecting kids’ mouthcare products to his list of responsibilities. When he's at his best, he has a tongue scraper and flosser in each hand, his body safeguards a power mouthbrush, and his head keeps the bad bacteria at bay.

  • body holds a Bristles sonic toothbrush
  • plays 2-minute songs for brush time
  • hands hold flossers and tongue scrapers (sold separately)
  • box transforms into Tooth Keri's Castle
  • augmented reality sticker: 'Tooth Keri' - your child's interactive guide to proper brushing and flossing, brought to life through engaging AR technology
  • recommended for ages: 2-12 years

reviews.name: Monserrat
reviews.title: Cute toothbrush
reviews.body: The caddy make her sink look fun. She loves it

reviews.name: Maryam
reviews.title: Very well made!
reviews.body: The collection of these brushes are so creative and engaging! I have purchased every design!

reviews.name: Donna
reviews.title: Cute but…
reviews.body: Not a type of electric brush I would recommend. It’s battery operated. The vibrations are weak. The one I received the button only works half of the time. I am being sent a replacement so I will follow up with how the button on that one fairs. I do like the soft and dense bristles of the brush. Very similar to a brand of manual toothbrush that I highly recommend. I like the holder it’s cute but very large which takes up too much space. I do not like how the head does not allow the bristles to dry.

reviews.name: Catherine
reviews.title: My Grandson Loved This Gift
reviews.body: I purchased this toothbrush set for my 4 year old grandson's birthday.  He was thrilled and excited.  This set has certainly helped with the daily toothbrushing experience.  It is cleverly done and fun for a small child just developing good dental hygiene habits.  I would recommend it to parents who want to formulate good routines for their children while having fun.
